rubric: Tark benchmark rubric, 12 points: strategy match 3 (gate below 2), risk/liquidity match 3, provider independence 2 (an affiliated provider is ineligible), data held 2, pricing basis match 2, threshold 7/12

selected.candidate: NCREIF Fund Index - ODCE (private core RE)
reasons: strategy_match 3/3: a private-market index of real estate for a core-plus non-traded real estate fund

risk_liquidity_match 2/3: appraisal-based index of periodically dealt funds (monthly dealing at NAV under 2% cap per month and 5% cap per quarter, requests prorated in the filings on record). The constituents' leverage regime is not typed in the record, so the full match is not claimed
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (NCREIF): the registry affiliation map ties it to none of the fund's advisers
data_held 0/2: cited, series not in the record: no comparison can be computed yet
selected.comparison_note: cited, series not in the record: no comparison computed

slot_g.label: Peer comparison (paragraphs (g) and (h))
member_names: Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, Inc.
slot_g.survivorship_note: The cohort is the roster's 3 surviving, still-filing products. Funds that closed, merged, or stopped filing are not in it, so any composite carries survivorship bias in the fund's favor. Membership rationales and exclusions are in the roster record.
slot_g.heterogeneity_note: Members span one wrapper type (non-traded REIT) and one leverage regime (charter-level borrowing limits, no 1940-Act coverage test). Fee bases, leverage and exit rights are not like-for-like, so the comparison is a history of similar investments, not a like-for-like index.

composite.weighting: equal-weight across peers, only over periods every peer reports
composite.statistic: relative wealth ratio vs peer composite
composite.not_pme_note: Not a public market equivalent: the peer composite is appraisal-based, constructed by the evaluator and cannot be bought.
composite.reason: fewer than 3 peers remain after leaving Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust Inc out (2: Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, Inc., JLL Income Property Trust, Inc.)
composite.candidate: Peer composite, non-traded real estate cohort without Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust Inc

comparison.comparator_kind: public market series (exchange-traded proxy, Yahoo adjusted close)

reference_comparison.note: reference comparison on the highest-ranked held public market series: not the meaningful benchmark

declared_none_reason: cell 5.1: BREIT declares no benchmark index anywhere in the FY2025 10-K

reasons: strategy_match 2/3: the public-market version of the asset class (listed REITs for core-plus non-traded real estate)

provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (Vanguard / MSCI US REIT): the registry affiliation map ties it to none of the fund's advisers
